slot_scores.name: minimum_ratio_productB_toA
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about a minimum demand ratio or that B must be at least three times A before READY_TO_MODEL; the constraint was only revealed by the user simulator after the agent had already stopped.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No minimum demand ratio between product B and product A exists, so any mix satisfying time and A-cap constraints is allowed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about or confirmed a B-to-A minimum ratio before entering READY_TO_MODEL and presenting the initial plan.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL and produced a plan while the P1 hidden slot H1 (minimum B-to-A ratio) remained unresolved; it was only supplied by the user simulator after the premature stop.

summary: The agent spent many turns on storage-capacity clarification and then stopped with a plan that silently omitted the key P1 demand-ratio constraint, which the user simulator had to reveal afterward. Interaction quality is poor because the core hidden business constraint was never elicited.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
